world_inputs.reproduction_boundary: The isolated original save and game assets remain local, not published. These non-personal parameters and hashes identify the actual run input; the seed alone does not reconstruct the saved NPC history.

scope.network: TCP/web loopback with ephemeral ports; query disabled; no public-server connection or client
scope.world: fresh isolated copy of the established single-player world; source world unchanged; no game assets or database contents published

input.protocol: One atomic two-record request+cancel append; wait for exact cancelled_before_native_action terminal; then one positive TalkToNpc TTL 60; no retries or further inputs.

run_control.shutdown: SIGUSR1 to the exact server PID; run-specific CLI grace 1 second; supervisor reported server exit 0

outcome.cancel: accepted then cancelled_before_native_action, one terminal event, no correlated speech/agent action
outcome.positive: accepted then native_talk_completed_without_speech, one terminal event; driver logged no agent effect through TTL+20 and started a 20-second post-request observation
